scope: Frontier fronts added by guide revision v2; separate from the eleven closure fronts and from the canonical ten-objective JSON

objectives.name: Central falsifiable hypothesis and nested function-class ablation
remaining: Preregister H-A to H-D; run free, passive and geometry-realizable classes on the same encoding and split

objectives.name: Fundamental theory and formally checked core
remaining: Reachable-set dimension study; Lean statements and proofs for the certificate lemmas T1-T5

objectives.name: Physical demonstrator and sim-to-real fidelity
remaining: Owner decision D0; partner, platform, transfer-matrix tomography and prospective predictions

objectives.name: End-to-end energy and latency at matched accuracy
remaining: Measured optical and electronic chain against the best electronic baseline; reference limits computed

objectives.name: Independent replication by another team
remaining: Results Reproduced or Replicated by people outside the project, with their own record

objectives.name: Adversarial review, blind analysis and registered report
remaining: Sealed test labels, red-team report, Stage 1 submission if the owner chooses that route

objectives.name: Open archive and citable release
remaining: Release DOI, Software Heritage identifier, CITATION.cff, container digest, data licences

objectives.name: Authorship, AI-use disclosure and ethics
remaining: CRediT roles agreed by real authors; AI-use statement; ethics approval before any new human data

objectives.name: External adoption and impact
remaining: Use by independent groups documented by them; cannot be produced by the project itself
